### Part A - Creating Mactrices

```{r}
# Create a 3x3 matrix called m1 containing the numbers 1 to 9, using matrix(1:9, nrow = 3, ncol = 3)
```

```{r}
matrix(1:9, nrow = 3, ncol = 3)
m1
```

<br>

```{r}
# .Create a second 3x3 matrix called m2 with the SAME numbers 1:9, but this time add the argument byrow = TRUE
```

```{r}
matrix(1:9, nrow = 3, ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)
m2
```
